task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

axes.name: answer_length
axes.description: 답변의 길이, 즉 문장 수와 단어 수의 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write a very brief summary with one or two short sentences.
Write a summary of about two sentences with moderate length.
Write a detailed summary with multiple sentences and more words.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 구조의 복잡성 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use short and simple sentences with straightforward structure.
Use sentences of moderate length with some complexity.
Use long and complex sentences with multiple clauses.

axes.name: hedging_level
axes.description: 확신의 정도, 즉 불확실성이나 조심스러운 표현 사용 빈도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write with confident and direct statements, avoiding hedging.
Include some cautious or hedging expressions to soften claims.
Use frequent hedging and cautious language to express uncertainty.

axes.name: numerical_inclusion
axes.description: 숫자나 구체적 수치를 포함하는 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Avoid using any numbers or specific numerical data.
Include some relevant numbers or statistics where appropriate.
Use many specific numbers and detailed statistics throughout.
